name: Family Breeding
source:
You play as a young man living together with four women. Your mother, your sister, your aunt and your cousin.

Your family has a slightly different tradition. It's customary for the women of the family, when they come of age, to have their first pregnancy with the unmarried man of the family, which in this case is you.

Living with four women, it's hard to resist temptation. Enjoy the adventure and have fun in "Family Breeding".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2853840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个与四个女人住在一起的年轻人。你的母亲，你的妹妹，你的阿姨和你的表弟。

你的家庭有一个略有不同的传统。按照惯例，家庭中的女性在成年后，会与家里的未婚男性（在本例中就是你）一起怀孕。

和四个女人住在一起，很难抗拒诱惑。在“家庭育种”中享受冒险、享受乐趣。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2853840/]Steam[/url]]
